title: CultureBank: An Online Community-Driven Knowledge Base Towards Culturally Aware Language Technologies
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a cultural knowledge base and benchmarking 'cultural awareness' in LLMs (e.g., social norms, etiquette, and traditions). While the dataset includes 'Religious Practices' as one of its 36 sub-topics, it represents less than 1% of the data volume. The paper does not include a significant or dedicated evaluation component specifically for religion, faith, or ethical/moral frameworks independent of general culture.
